description: This Java source file defines the HashCrypt utility class, which provides various methods for cryptographic hashing, password hashing, and comparison functions, primarily focusing on SHA-based and PBKDF2 hashing algorithms.

classes.name: HashCrypt
classes.description: Utility class providing cryptographic hashing functions, password encryption, and comparison methods using SHA and PBKDF2 algorithms.

methods.name: getMessageDigest
methods.description: Returns a MessageDigest instance for the specified type (e.g., SHA-1, SHA-256).

methods.name: comparePassword
methods.description: Compares a stored encrypted password with a provided plain text password, supporting multiple hash formats.

methods.name: doCompareTypePrefix
methods.description: Handles comparison for hashes with a {type} prefix.

methods.name: doComparePosix
methods.description: Handles comparison for POSIX-style crypt hashes.

methods.name: doCompareBare
methods.description: Handles comparison for bare hashes without prefix.

methods.name: cryptPassword
methods.description: Generates a hash for a password with a specified hash type and salt.

methods.name: cryptUTF8
methods.description: Hashes a string value with a specified hash type and salt, encoding the string in UTF-8.

methods.name: cryptValue
methods.description: Hashes a string value with a specified hash type and salt, primarily for cryptographic purposes.

methods.name: cryptBytes
methods.description: Hashes byte array data with a specified hash type and salt, returning a formatted string.

methods.name: getCryptedBytes
methods.description: Generates a cryptographic digest, combining salt and data, and encodes it in Base64.

methods.name: pbkdf2HashCrypt
methods.description: Generates a PBKDF2-based hash for a password with a salt and specified hash type.

methods.name: doComparePbkdf2
methods.description: Verifies a PBKDF2 hash against a provided password.

methods.name: digestHash
methods.description: Computes a hash of a string with a specified hash type and optional character encoding.

methods.name: digestHash64
methods.description: Computes a Base64-encoded hash of byte data with a specified hash type.

methods.name: digestHashOldFunnyHex
methods.description: Computes a hash and encodes it using an old custom hex encoding method.
